notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.5
notes.content:
A few more bug fixes, with special thanks to Ventz Petkov for the great bug reporting!

[h2]Gameplay Fixes[/h2]

- Object collision fixes for things like the Western Tower entrance, lightning barrier, etc.

- The shield in the Freestad Caves should no longer be on the wrong layer.

- Leith's bed should now have physical form, preventing you from walking through it like a creeping ghost.

- When switching between mouse and gamepad or using the Steam Deck trackpad as a mouse, the player's toolbar should no longer switch selection when moving if the mouse was left resting over the toolbar.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.4
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay Fixes[/h2]

- Game should now correctly resume at fullscreen when returning from screensaver or alt-tab.

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]

- Gamepad / Steam Deck users should now see tile highlighting when farming to help with your farm layout and seed placement.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

- [b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b] : Synching games across platforms and devices should now be possible via Steam Cloud. To ensure you have this functionality enabled, open Steam and click Steam -> Settings -> Cloud.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

- Naval combat victories should now correctly update the coins displayed from the coins you get as plunder.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay FIxes[/h2]
- Fixed surface rendering and mouse coordinates in windowed and widescreen modes.

- Steam Deck ocean optimizations

- Cave tile fixes

[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
- Better quest descriptions for initial Pirate and Global Trade quests.

- Improved mushroom hit box

- Expanded melee hit box

- Goblin boss damage decreased from 10 to 9

notes.title: Dreaming Isles is Live!
notes.content:
After more than four years of work, Dreaming Isles is out! 

In a way, this is only the beginning. I'm already starting work on the 1.1 Homestead update, which you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2258320/discussions/0/4346607305579890858/]read about here[/url].

I'm a solo developer, a husband and father, and a lifelong fan of video games. Thank you for taking a look. I sincerely hope you enjoy my game.

-YawningDad

notes.title: Chapters, Achievements, and More
notes.content:
With less than a month to go before launch, I've been wrapping up design and development for chapter one of Dreaming Isles. Along with some final gameplay functionality, I've implemented Steam achievements and Steam screenshot functionality. 

From here until launch I'll be playtesting and bug fixing to the best of my abilities. I'm sure there will be bugs post-launch (what game has ever launched without any?), but I'll do my best to find and squash as many as I can.

Soon after launch I'll begin working on Chapter Two's content. You can read more about the three planned chapters here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2258320/discussions/0/4346607305579890858/

To be clear, the follow-up chapters two and three will be free updates, and the initial release will be a complete game. I just want to set expectations that the story will continue post-release.

Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted Dreaming Isles! I hope you enjoy it when it releases on January 13th!

-YawningDad

notes.title: A Change in Release Date
notes.content:
Being a solo dev is wonderful for so many reasons, but it also has some downsides. One of those is the inability to test and debug every scenario and every possible sequence of events in a game as complex as a farm sim. No matter how much testing I do, until the game is in the hands of many people, I can't know all the bugs that are lurking and ready to leap out.

It also means that it's difficult to see the forest for the trees as far as gameplay goes. It's hard to see the big picture of how it feels for a first-time player to experience the game.

Now that more people have played it, I've come to the painful conclusion that Dreaming Isles is not quite ready for release. It needs more polish, more debugging, and more gameplay clarity.

So, as difficult as this is, I'm pushing the release back to January of 2025. I want to do right by you, the player, and I want to release something that I'm proud of.

I apologize to anyone who has been anticipating the game (all three of you!). I hope this will make for a better experience come January.

Thank you.
-YawningDad

notes.title: The Dreaming Isles demo is live!
notes.content:
After nearly three years of work, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2258320/Dreaming_Isles/]Dreaming Isles demo[/url] is live and available to play on Windows, Mac, and Linux! The full game will be out later this year, but I've tried to include many of the key features from the game. 

Start your farm, meet some of the islanders, earn your first boat, sail around the Isles, engage in naval battles, and craft items to help you on your journey.

The full game will have more islands and areas to explore, a boat workshop that will allow you to store and upgrade multiple boats, a fishing mini game, boat races, festivals, deeper relationships, and many more islanders to meet!

I'll be patching bugs as I find them, and making a few updates to the demo here and there, but I really hope you enjoy Dreaming Isles! Thank you so much for playing!

-YawningDad

notes.title: Dreaming Isles Demo and Next Fest Update
notes.content:
Hi all!

I'm getting closer to completing the playable demo for Dreaming Isles. It should be ready by the new year, but possibly sooner. Dreaming Isles will be in the February Next Fest, so I plan to get the demo out well ahead of that. I want to get plenty of testing, feedback, and debugging done prior to the fest!

I'm a solo developer, a dad of two, and a full-time worker, so it's hard to give exact dates. Thank you so much to everyone who has followed and wishlisted Dreaming Isles! It's been my dream to do this for decades, and I'm grateful for all of your support!

Sincerely,
YawningDad

notes.title: Playable Demo Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hi all,

I'm busy working on a playable demo for Dreaming Isles that I hope to have ready by the fall. It will take you through the intro and some initial quests, let you start your farm and earn your first boat, and even sail to some neighboring islands. Hopefully it will show (or at least hint at) the full features and loop of the game in an interesting and fun way!

Back to work I go.

-YawningDad
